definitions.explanation: A seat that is assigned in advance and requires prior reservation, commonly used for trains, planes, and venues.

examples.japanese: {新幹線|しんかんせん}の{指定席|していせき}を{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: I reserved a seat on the Shinkansen.

examples.japanese: {指定席|していせき}は{追加料金|ついかりょうきん}がかかる。
{連休|れんきゅう}は{指定席|していせき}が{取|と}りにくい。
examples.english: It's hard to get reserved seats during consecutive holidays.

notes:
FORMATION:
{指定|してい} (designation/specification) + {席|せき} (seat)

CONTRAST:
・{指定席|していせき} - reserved seat (assigned seat)
・{自由席|じゆうせき} - unreserved seat (first-come, first-served)
・{グリーン車|しゃ} - Green Car (first class, all reserved)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{指定席|していせき}を{予約|よやく}する - to reserve a seat
・{指定席|していせき}を{取|と}る - to get a reserved seat
・{指定席|していせき}{券|けん} - reserved seat ticket
・{指定席|していせき}{車両|しゃりょう} - reserved seat car

TRAIN CONTEXT:
On Japanese trains like the Shinkansen, reserved seats typically cost an additional fee ({指定席|していせき}{料金|りょうきん}) on top of the base fare.
